questions.stem: A data engineer with write permission on a lakehouse wants other teams to know it's ready to reuse. Which endorsement can they apply themselves?

options.text: Master data, because lakehouses are items that contain data
Promoted
Certified, once they request it from the workspace's admin
Certified, because write permission on an item includes certifying it

questions.explanation: Any user with write permissions on an item can promote it. Certified and Master data can be applied only by users a Fabric administrator specifies.

questions.stem: Who can certify a semantic model?

options.text: Any member of the workspace that holds the semantic model
Anyone who requests certification for the item
Only users a Fabric administrator has specified
Any user with write permission on the semantic model

questions.explanation: Anyone can request certification, but only users specified by a Fabric administrator can certify items, and only if an administrator enabled certification.

questions.stem: A lakehouse is labelled Confidential. What happens to items built from it, such as a semantic model that reads it?

options.text: Nothing: each dependent item keeps whatever label it had, until someone labels it by hand
The label moves to the dependent items and is removed from the lakehouse
The dependent items are blocked from reading the lakehouse until they carry the same label
The label propagates downstream to the dependent items, since downstream inheritance is on by default

questions.explanation: When a sensitivity label is applied to an item, it propagates downstream to all dependent items. Downstream inheritance is on by default.

questions.stem: Where does the SQL analytics endpoint that a lakehouse creates for itself get its sensitivity label?

options.text: From the source systems the lakehouse's data first came from
It has no label until someone applies one to it directly
From its parent lakehouse
From the workspace's default label, set in the workspace settings

questions.explanation: Autogenerated items from a lakehouse or data warehouse take their label from the parent lakehouse or data warehouse, not from items further upstream.

questions.stem: Which two must be true for a user to apply sensitivity labels to Fabric items?

options.text: The item is already Certified or Promoted
The label is published to the user in its label policy
The user has the Admin role in the workspace that holds the item
The user is among the users specified when sensitivity labels were enabled for the tenant

questions.explanation: Being in the specified users list isn't enough: the label must also be published to the user as part of the label's policy.
